name: cf-cross-border
description: Use this Central African Republic cross-border Guide for 2026 research on arrivals, departure tax clearance, foreign services, branch income and foreign transfers. It separates personal residence from corporate territoriality and explains the three-month tax-regularity attestation introduced in the signed 2025 supplementary budget, including its shorter validity where debt is stayed. Search triggers include quitus fiscal, attestation de régularité fiscale, foreign bank transfer, expatriate departure, service withholding and foreign branch. Baseline code provisions and directly read amendments are distinguished. Treaty rates, immigration outcomes and live administrative workflows remain unresolved, so this Guide cannot authorise a payment or filing.
